channel_scope.reason: The unique-leaf pre-factor locator is clean on total2 112-143 but the same pre-factor policy family false-positives on the known total3/4 120-127 negative-control surface.

pre_factor_gate.name: pre_factor_nonvacuous_hit_root_proxy
conditions: full materialized FFE surface has at least one selected root pair
selected public leaf has at least one known hit root before factorization

primary_root_policy.name: prefactor_unique_leaf_hit_root_first_target_hash
primary_root_policy.policy_identity_selection_rule: selected before 144-151 from the 136-143 fresh follow-up: it removed the selected-hit-root false positive using only pre-factor selected-leaf hit-root multiplicity, giving 6/6 preserving, zero false positives, and 6/6 direct-below-rho
algorithm: read pre_factor_selected_hit_roots and pre_factor_selected_hit_root_pairs from the preregistered gate manifest
rank Sage root-hyperplane candidates whose root is in that pre-factor selected-hit-root set first
within that set, prefer roots coming from selected leaves with fewer pre-factor hit roots
fall back to target_root_hash among tied or non-hit-root candidates
stop at the first public-zero root hyperplane
charge all selector work plus root-scan or direct-root accounting

promotion_condition: After generating the 144-151 total2 strict signature and pre-factor manifest, factor only total2 gate-selected surfaces and score prefactor_unique_leaf_hit_root_first_target_hash. Count as a total2 direct-root promotion only if all total2 gate-selected surfaces are preserving, false-positive-free, and direct-below-rho. Count as a stronger scan-positive promotion only if all selected surfaces are also scan-below-rho.
non_claims: This does not promote total3/4 surfaces.
This does not claim end-to-end ECDLP recovery faster than Pollard rho.
This does not claim scan-positive promotion unless the conservative root-scan route is below rho on every selected surface.
